name: pi-tool-repair-layer
description: Intercepts tool calls and repairs common LLM argument mistakes before execution — null stripping, JSON parsing, array wrapping, markdown path cleanup, relational defaults, and schema-aware extra property stripping.
author: Cali

scripts.setup:hooks: git config core.hooksPath scripts/hooks && chmod +x scripts/hooks/pre-commit && echo 'pre-commit hook installed. Bypass with: git commit --no-verify'
